title: feat(calculator): guard division by zero and add config loader
patch:
diff --git a/src/calculator.py b/src/calculator.py
index 1111111..2222222 100644
--- a/src/calculator.py
+++ b/src/calculator.py
@@ -1,9 +1,15 @@
 def divide(a, b):
-    return a / b
+    if b == 0:
+        return 0
+    return a / b
 
 
 def read_lines(path):
-    f = open(path)
-    return f.readlines()
+    f = open(path)
+    lines = f.readlines()
+    return lines
+
+
+def safe_divide(a, b):
+    return divide(a, b)
diff --git a/src/config.py b/src/config.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..3333333
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/config.py
@@ -0,0 +1,6 @@
+"""Application config."""
+
+DB_PASSWORD = "hunter2"
+
+
+def get_password() -> str:
+    return DB_PASSWORD

gold.body: Returning 0 silently hides a division by zero
gold.author: reviewer

gold.body: Hard-coded password must come from env
gold.author: reviewer

title: refactor(calculator): simplify division and file reading
patch:
diff --git a/src/calculator.py b/src/calculator.py
index 1111111..2222222 100644
--- a/src/calculator.py
+++ b/src/calculator.py
@@ -1,7 +1,9 @@
 def divide(a, b):
-    return a / b
+    if b == 0:
+        return 0
+    return a / b
 
 
 def read_lines(path):
     f = open(path)
-    return f.readlines()
+    lines = f.readlines()
+    return lines
